comments.body:
Correct name for this discovery: Silver Figurine of Artemis

Quest name: Praise Our Great Goddess
Quest location: Seville / Lisbon / London / Marseille Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r1 Search, r3 Theology, GER(German)
Pre-requisite discovery: Temple of Artemis discovery (from "The Truth of the Temple" quest) + Theophanes's Chronicle discovery (from "After the Giant Statue" quest)
Unlocked Legacy Theme: "Ehpesus the Land of Goddess"

P.S.: Typo on the Legacy Theme name, should be Ephesus instead
